name: Steak & Green Pepper Quesadillas
desc: Southwest-spiced steak and green pepper quesadillas with pepper jack and a smoky red pepper crema.

source.title: Steak & Green Pepper Quesadillas with Hot Sauce & Smoky Red Pepper Crema
source.evidence: The site recipe is HelloFresh's 2-serving card: same ingredients and quantities, same order of cooking.

ingredients.raw: 1 long green pepper (Anaheim type) or green bell pepper
ingredients.item: long green pepper or green bell pepper

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp HelloFresh Southwest spice blend (or taco seasoning)
Salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Halve, core, and thinly slice the green pepper crosswise into strips. Pat the steak dry with paper towels.
Heat half the oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the pepper, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, 3 to 4 minutes.

Add the steak and season with the Southwest spice, pepper, and a big pinch of salt. Cook, stirring, until the steak is browned and cooked through and the pepper is tender, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from the pan and wipe it out.
Sprinkle pepper jack over one half of each tortilla. Top with the steak mixture and the Mexican cheese, then fold in half.
Heat the remaining oil in the same pan over medium heat. Cook the quesadillas until golden brown and the cheese has melted, 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Cut each quesadilla into 3 wedges. Stir the hot sauce into the crema, or dollop the crema on top and drizzle with hot sauce, and serve.
tips: Without the HelloFresh crema, stir a pinch of smoked paprika or chipotle powder into 4 tbsp sour cream.
